verdict.rationale: Docs show Context.dev scraping pages directly into Markdown, crawling sites into Markdown, and converting documents to Markdown for AI agents. Browser actions (click/scroll/wait) and page rendering suggest JS-rendered pages are handled for the user, and the vendor-cited SiteGPT migration supports knowledge-base use. Community questions about proxies are open skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented anti-blocking/proxy handling, explicit docs on HTML cleanup/boilerplate removal quality, independent hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.
